text: The boat approaches the first dock near occupied and inflated costmap cells. Nav2 predicts a collision along the commanded motion, aborts FollowPath, clears the local costmap, and restarts control. The user observed a dock collision, but retained physical-contact telemetry reports zero prohibited contacts; this evidence confirms a collision prediction and recovery, while actual impact remains unconfirmed.

sources.claim: Real Unity first-dock approach view; overlay can obscure hull/dock boundaries.
Received plan, odometry and local occupancy grid; first dock closer than second; per-topic timestamps retained.
Nav2 collision prediction, abort, costmap clear and restart; log timestamp is distinct from screenshot timestamp.
Five-second measured first-slip containment; strict timing validity fails; contact count zero.

temporalRelation: First-dock photo was requested approximately 6.68 wall seconds before the controller collision prediction, not at physical impact.
